rule: Correlation counts as strong when |r| is 0.5 or more on the 60-day window (starting threshold, untested). Measured, never assumed.

drivers.secondOrder: Higher 2Y also tightens financial conditions, can slow growth later.
Cheaper gas lowers inflation, which gives ECB room to cut (helps thesis long term).
Gilt selloff on fiscal fear can flip to GBP-negative (risk premium).
Oil up also hurts JPY (importer). Near 160 the MoF can override everything.
A risk-off spike pulls haven money into CHF against the thesis.
Oil up lifts Canada's terms of trade + headline CPI, so BoC may cut less: hits the thesis, not just price.
China stimulus headlines can gap AUD regardless of RBA.
Falling dairy hits farm incomes, adds to RBNZ cut pressure.

commodities.note: Commodities get their own bias + driver rows later (oil, gold, copper).
